[[Sahnlae the Tamer]] is a [[pet tamer]], a type of NPC who allows players to remove their current [[Animal companion|pet]] in order to gain a new one.

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Sunqua Vale}} (outside [[Shing Jea Monastery]])

==Dialogue==
{{dialogue-stub}}
:''"Greetings, <character name>. My name is Sahnleae the Tamer. I've traveled the world in search of creatures both common and exotic for the [[Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area)|emperor's menagerie]]. You look like the adventuring type. Would you like me to take a look at your pet?"''
:'''What do you do with the animals you collect?'''
::''"I am in the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor's]] service, tasked with searching lands far and wide for animals to add to his great menagerie. The emperor has quite a soft spot for the creatures of the earth, air, and sea."''
